loop.top3_why: The trimmed_mean strategy (pool1, 20% trim) shows the lowest validation score and the most stable per‑window performance (0.6607, 0.6290, 0.4941). The weighted and mean strategies have slightly higher scores and less stability across windows, and the weighted approach relies on inverse‑error weights that may overfit given only three validation windows.
loop.top3_why_not: B and C have marginally higher validation scores and less per‑window consistency. B’s inverse‑error weighting can amplify noise from a single window, while C’s plain mean includes all five models without trimming, leading to higher error in the first window. Given the series’ unstable ranking and strong seasonality, the trimmed_mean offers the safest generalization.
